integrity: Universal proof uses exact derivative signs and a strict hyperbolic monotonicity lemma, and includes all equality and boundary cases. A separately executable deterministic finite diagnostic supplements but does not replace the proof. Source inspection access and originality limits are disclosed. No independent scientific audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic two identical equal-area patches, one fixed identical predator per patch, identical generalized Type III Hill response with real exponent above one, and divisible prey budget. This is an instantaneous predator intake optimization, not a population-dynamics, welfare, or evolutionary prediction. Historical priority is provisional because broad sigmoidal allocation theory may contain an equivalent specialization and the Real (1977) full text was inaccessible.
title: Two sharp patch-allocation transitions for a generalized Type III feeding response
